title: Replace .ok()? with proper error propagation in routing/router.rs
description: lichen-node/src/routing/router.rs uses .ok()? to convert DaoError and other structured errors into None, losing diagnostic context. Replace each .ok()? with either: (a) ? operator if the function returns a compatible Result, or (b) .map_err(|e| { log::debug!('...'); e }).ok()? if Option return is required. List each .ok()? call and decide. Do not change function signatures. Verify: cd rust && cargo test -p lichen-node
